verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat, agent mode, and MCP context features (docs-4, docs-20, docs-22) allow asking about code and getting explanations, and docs-9 mentions building a 'shared source of truth' from docs/repos, which could help orient a developer. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated codebase-mapping or architecture-overview feature, and community feedback focuses on line-level completion quality rather than big-picture navigation.
